INSERT INTO caa_licences (citizen_id, licence_no, category, status, expires)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id, licence_no) DO UPDATE SET
              licence_no = EXCLUDED.licence_no, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, expires = EXCLUDED.expires
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
